about: Labelled resurfacing cases for the demo content. Refs are content ids: front matter ids for notes, docs and meetings, and page ids from history.json. Section is where a card belongs in the Related panel: docs is Notes / Docs (notes, Google files, Notion, Granola), sites is Sites (pages that were only read). Each panel section shows up to 3 cards, so a case never lists more than 3 musts per section.

howToScore.must: Should appear in its section. A miss is a recall failure.
howToScore.nice: Good if it appears. Not a failure if it doesn't.
howToScore.acceptable: Fine either way. Don't count it as a false positive.
howToScore.shouldNotSurface: Appearing anywhere is a precision failure.
howToScore.atMostOneOf: At most one item from each group may appear. Both appearing is a failure.
howToScore.onScreen: Visible next to the context, so the app hides it. Ignore it when scoring.
